create_multi_corpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusSampledDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with uniform sampling
build_custom_sampler: build a custom sampling function to pass to MultiCorpusSampledDataset for non-uniform corpus selection
collate_multi_corpus_batch: collate samples from multiple corpora by selecting one dataset via the sampling function
map_index_to_dataset: map a global index to a specific underlying dataset using wraparound logic
prefetch_multi_corpus: prefetch data across all underlying datasets by mapping indices and calling each dataset prefetch
